fields.display_title: This paper proposes a training algorithm based on Layer-wise Adaptive Rate Scaling (LARS) to overcome the optimization difficulties for training with large batch size. The authors use a linear scaling and warm-up scheme to train AlexNet on ImageNet. The results show promising performance when using a relatively large batch size. The presented method is interesting. However, the experiments are poorly organized since some necessary descriptions and discussions are missing.
